MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
